proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 *dhūḍi/dhūli gives dhūr/dhūl/dhulo dust, northern duṛi and discusses variation dh/t. These simple dust responses preserve that family with the source aspiration and retroflex details retained. Reviewed comparison: kul dʊɭə “dust” (f_s6vahnhnjrgwo). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.

The t-final hot forms fit these documented continuations; tapo and talo need distinguishing verbal or lateral developments. Reviewed comparison: Rana tʌto “hot” (f_zfk6l2aerrnyo).
